8.29.7.3. iLock_Geography.predicate_library.path_area.PathInArea.getMatches¶

PathInArea.getMatches(*pattern)¶

Return an iterator that iterates each true point of the predicate that matches the pattern.

Parameters:pattern (vtuple(GeoType | IRailyardComponent | None)) – The pattern the returned true points are matched with.
Return type:Iterable(IRailyardComponent)
Returns:Return an iterator that iterates over the matched tuple of objects.
